title: VeinoGate Dashboard Runtime Configuration
description: Deploy-time, non-secret configuration fetched by the dashboard at startup. Must contain no credentials, tokens, or patient data.

mode.description: Declares the deployment's own intent. It never causes the app to switch modes at runtime -- that is fixed at build time by which entry point (index.html vs demo.html) was built. This field only relaxes the http(s)/ws(s) scheme check for local test/mock targets.

stale_after_seconds.description: Client-side display staleness budget. Independent of clinical calibration thresholds, which always come from the Jetson's calibration object on each message.
